sections.Profile:
"Monte Carlo" and "Odds & Evens" are two closely related electro-mechanical pinball machines produced by Bally Manufacturing Co. in 1973. "Monte Carlo" is the four-player version, while "Odds & Evens" is the single-player version. Both machines share a similar gambling and card game theme designed by Jim Patla with artwork by Dave Christensen.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1973
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Gambling, Card games, Casino, Original Theme, 1970s
